theater: 中阿拉伯內志、希臘茲與也門

battle.name: 里達戰爭
battle.theater: 中阿拉伯內志、希臘茲與也門
battle.brief: 632年6月穆罕默德去世，麥地那與中阿拉伯各部落隨即決裂，夏秋之間全面叛教。哈立德·本·瓦利德率騎兵連戰布賴德哈、布扎阿與雅馬麥，戰線直抵也門。卡面長矛在此以騎兵機動為主的戰役裡，是步兵守門、騎兵衝鋒的基本兵器，與拜占庭、薩珊的葉形矛頭同源。里達最終以部族歸順、外來干預失敗告終。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 里達戰爭（亦稱叛教之戰，阿拉伯語 ردة）是先知穆罕默德於632年6月8日去世後爆發的第一次內戰。穆斯林一方由麥加的遷士與麥地那的輔士組成，哈里發阿布·伯克爾在麥地那握有最高調度權，先以「樹下宣誓」定盟約，再以書記、徵稅官與徵兵使把散居部族編入國家框架。作戰上分派數路遠征：哈立德·本·瓦利德率主力南下希臘茲與內志，舒拉希勒·本·阿姆爾·加法里輔之；伊亞德·本·加尼姆向東敘利亞邊境推進；烏薩馬·本·扎伊德指向巴勒斯坦；另遣使者往巴林，聯絡當地與阿拉伯海東岸的拉赫姆人。遠征編制以騎兵為骨幹，步兵與弓手為輔，每支部隊配書記、軍需、標程與掌旗，行軍以駱駝馱載糧秣與旗鼓。叛軍一方並非國家軍隊，而是部族聯盟：塔米姆、蘇萊姆、哈萬津、塔格利卜、基拉卜、歐卡伊爾、卡爾斯等未改宗或假改宗的部落，加上也門的希姆亞里特勢力與薩珊駐軍殘部。雙方都靠外力輸血：薩珊王雅茲德格爾德三世派使者向馬利克·本·努韋拉許諾出兵與金錢，拜占庭則以使節與金幣支援希臘茲與提哈馬的部落，並在巴林扶植自己的代理人。於是這場戰爭的實質，是阿拉伯聯盟內部對「誰來收稅、誰來定秩序」的第一次正面撕裂，也是舊部族秩序瓦解後留下的真空被重新填補的過程。
countriesEn: The Ridda War, also called the War of the Apostasy (Arabic: ردة), broke out in the summer of 632, immediately after the death of the Prophet Muhammad on 8 June 632, and it was the first civil war of the new community. On the Muslim side stood the Meccan emigrants and the Medinan helpers, with the caliph Abu Bakr holding supreme command in Medina. He first fixed the community through the pledge of the tree, then attached clerks, revenue collectors and recruiting agents to the tribal base in order to turn a loose confederation into a state. Operations were split into several columns: Khalid ibn al-Walid took the main body south into the Hijaz and central Najd, assisted by Shurahbil ibn Amr al-Ghifari; Iyad ibn Ghanim was pushed towards the Syrian frontier; Usama ibn Zayd was sent towards Palestine; and separate envoys were dispatched to Bahrain to make contact with the Lakhmids on the coast of the Arabian Sea. Field columns were cavalry-heavy, with infantry and archers in support; each column carried a clerk, a quartermaster, a surveyor and a standard-bearer, and camels bore the grain, the spare weapons and the banners. The insurgents were not an army in the modern sense but a tribal coalition: the tribes of Tamim, Sulaym, Hawazin, Taghlib, Kilab, Uqayl, Ka'bs and Udal, some of whom had never truly converted and others of whom had only pretended, joined by the Himyarite party in Yemen and by the survivors of the Sassanid garrison. What makes this war unusual is that both sides were fed from outside: the Sassanid king Yazdegerd III sent an envoy to Malik ibn Nuwayra with promises of troops and money, while Byzantium supplied envoys and coin to the tribes of the Hijaz and of Tihama and kept its own client in Bahrain. The Ridda was therefore the first open rupture inside the Arab coalition over who would collect the taxes and who would set the order, and at the same time the moment when the vacuum left by the collapse of the old tribal order was filled in by something else.
people: 決策層是哈里發阿布·伯克爾（632至634年在位），他在穆罕默德去世後數日之內被確定為「代理人」，面對的第一道難題不是外敵而是叛教。他立刻把戰爭分成兩個戰區：中阿拉伯交給最受信賴的指揮官哈立德·本·瓦利德，此人出身於阿布·加法爾系，父祖皆為部族將領，部眾視之為「真主之劍」；北方戰線交給舒拉希勒·本·阿姆爾·加法里、伊亞德·本·加尼姆與烏薩馬·本·扎伊德三人，目的是不讓叛軍與敘利亞、巴勒斯坦的拜占庭邊境連成一片。哈立德麾下有穆哈拉布·本·杜威德等輔士出身的老將，以及一批「樹下宣誓」時代的遷士與輔士骨幹；另有書記、標程與軍需人員隨軍理事。叛軍領袖是塔米姆族的馬利克·本·努韋拉，他同時與波斯與拜占庭保持聯繫，並得到波斯方面供應的兵力與器械；塔格利卜、蘇萊姆、歐卡伊爾等族各推自己的首領。直接導火線的製造者是十二人代表之一的穆斯納德·本·哈里斯，他殺死談判使者，穆罕默德當即指責「他們來求和，你卻殺了他們的使者」，此後再也無法收拾。文學方面，阿迪·本·扎伊德與阿斯蘭族的阿斯拉米在雅馬麥戰後的唇槍對答，成為本役最著名的文字殘章；歐麥爾其後派阿卜杜·拉赫曼·本·奧夫與塔米姆訂立協議。也門線上有穆哈吉爾·本·阿比·烏拜、其子穆罕默德·本·穆罕默德、阿拉·哈德拉米與艾斯瓦德·安西等人；薩珊守將瓦赫茲則據馬里卜與內地。
peopleEn: The decision-maker was the caliph Abu Bakr, in office from 632 to 634, who was established as the successor within days of Muhammad's death and whose first problem was not a foreign enemy but the apostasy itself. He immediately divided the war into two theatres: central Arabia went to the commander he trusted most, Khalid ibn al-Walid, a man of the Abu Jahl line whose father and grandfather had been tribal commanders and whom the tribes called the Sword of God; the northern front was given to Shurahbil ibn Amr al-Ghifari, Iyad ibn Ghanim and Usama ibn Zayd, so that the insurgents could not join up with the Byzantine frontier in Syria and Palestine. Under Khalid served veterans of the Ansar such as Muhallab ibn Dhuwayd, together with a core of emigrants and helpers who had taken the pledge of the tree, and the column also carried clerks, surveyors and quartermasters to handle matters on the march. The insurgent leader was Malik ibn Nuwayra of Tamim, who kept in touch with both Persia and Byzantium and received troops and equipment from the Persian side; Taghlib, Sulaym, Uqayl and the others each put up their own chief. The man who lit the fuse was Musnad ibn al-Harith, one of the twelve delegates, who killed the emissary that had come to negotiate; the Prophet immediately rebuked him with the words that they had come seeking peace and he had killed their messenger, and from that point nothing could be patched up. On the literary side, the exchange of satirical verse between Adi ibn Zayd and al-Aslami of the Aslam after the battle of Yamama is the most famous surviving trace of this campaign. Later, Umar sent Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf to conclude a treaty with Tamim. On the Yemenite side were Muhajir ibn Abi Ubayya, his son Muhammad ibn Muhammad, al-Ala al-Hadrami and al-Aswad al-Ansi, while the Sassanid commander Wahrez held Ma'rib and the interior.
kits: 卡面這件「埃及長矛」代表長矛最原始的樣態：早王朝時期的埃及人把銅或青銅矛頭以束縛方式綁在木杆上，用它守城垣，也用它去收復失地。到632年，這個「杆加葉形頭」的結構仍是阿拉伯半島步兵與騎兵的基本武裝，只不過矛頭已由銅改為鍛鐵。阿拉伯語稱長矛為「拉姆哈」（رمح），杆是約兩公尺的硬木，矛頭為細長的柳葉形，銳角很窄，便於在密集隊形中連續刺擊；它既可由步兵持以守門牆，也可夾在馬鞍上作為騎兵衝鋒的武器，正是「守城垣」與「收復失地」兩種用法的直接延續。對手的長矛形制幾乎一致：拜占庭步兵所用的葉形矛頭長槍（史家常以希臘語「帕拉梅里翁」稱之，所指仍有爭議），以及薩珊騎兵的長矛，都採窄葉形頭、便於連續突刺。叛軍的裝備以弓、箭、投槍、小刀與皮甲為主，馬利克·本·努韋拉的隊伍另有波斯方面供應的馬匹與器械。防護上，穆斯林用木製圓盾與皮製小盾，薩珊輕騎用札甲與圓盾，拜占庭邊軍用鈎鍊式札甲。交通完全依靠雙峰駱駝，隊伍以駱駝隊形行進，每頭駱駝馱人與裝備。攻城器械在塔伊弗之圍中首次大量出現：穆斯林把投石機（manjaniq）與可移動的塔車運到城下，與拜占庭式的配重投石和攻城塔同場。阿拉伯傳統另有一條與卡面直接相關的記載：先知穆罕默德未留下財產，只留下長矛、馬鞍、頭巾與甲胄一類的軍用物，那把「遺產之矛」在後世想像中便成了軍權的象徵。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card stands for the oldest form of the weapon: in the early dynastic period the Egyptians lashed a copper or bronze head onto a wooden shaft, used it to hold city walls and used it again to recover lost ground. By 632 that same construction, a shaft plus a leaf-shaped head, was still the basic armament of infantry and cavalry across the Arabian peninsula, except that the head was now forged iron. Arabic calls the long spear ramiḥ (رمح): the shaft is about two metres of hardwood and the head is a narrow lanceolate blade with a thin point, made for repeated thrusts inside a crowded formation. It could be carried by infantry to defend a gate and it could be couched under a rider's arm for the charge, which is a direct continuation of the two uses in the card's history. The opponents used almost the same pattern: the leaf-headed long spear of Byzantine infantry, which historians often call the paramerion in Greek though the exact sense of the term is disputed, and the lance of the Sassanid cavalry, both with narrow leaf-shaped heads built for repeated stabbing. The insurgents were equipped mainly with bows, arrows, javelins, daggers and leather armour, while the following of Malik ibn Nuwayra included horses and machines supplied by the Persians. For protection the Muslims used round wooden shields and small leather shields, the Sassanid light horse wore lamellar armour with a round shield, and the Byzantine frontier troops used klivanion-style mail. Movement depended entirely on two-humped camels, the column moving in camel order with each animal carrying men and equipment. Siege machines appeared in bulk for the first time during the siege of Ta'if, where the Muslims hauled mangonels and movable towers into range against Sassanid-style counterweight throwers and a Byzantine siege tower. Arab tradition also preserves a note directly tied to the card: Muhammad left no wealth behind, only things of war such as the lance, the saddle, the turban and the armour, and that inherited lance became in later imagination the symbol of military authority.
tactics: 哈立德的戰法基本是「騎兵機動、據點封鎖、快速打擊」。第一步是切斷水源與道路：在薩法爾十一年（632年夏末）的布扎阿之戰，他把塔米姆與蘇萊姆聯軍擠在布扎阿的井群附近，使敵方在給水上受限；穆哈拉姆十一年的布賴德哈之戰，則是率騎兵在麥地那東北的山口迎擊蘇萊姆與哈萬津聯軍，奪其營帳與牲畜。追擊時他不急於正面硬撼，而是先用小股騎兵反覆挑釁、迫敵散開，再以主力從側翼一次壓上；隨即派騎兵封鎖各部族的營地與水井，迫其派代表談判。史家流傳的告誡「莫去拉那野貓的尾巴」正出現在布扎阿一役，反映當時將領對分兵追擊的警惕。面對城寨時他改用圍城術：對塔伊弗，他自麥加東南方向逼近，把投石機與箭樓推到射程內，強攻城門數日不成，又屢遭守軍出城反突，最終因城堅、援軍不絕而解除圍城，率軍退回麥加方向。也門戰線上，兩支分遣隊沿紅海東岸南下，一支以穆哈吉爾·本·阿比·烏拜為主，經納季蘭、哈德拉毛直取薩那，一支沿海岸推進，目的是切斷薩珊守軍的海上補給；奪取桑訥後雙方在城內達成協議，由也門本地勢力出面驅逐波斯籍總督。整體而言，這批軍隊沒有固定的攻城器械體系，卻靠騎兵速度、標程測距與連續的驛站式傳令，完成了半個阿拉伯半島的縱深追擊。
tacticsEn: Khalid's method was basically cavalry manoeuvre, blockade of fixed points, and fast striking. The first step was to cut roads and water: in the battle of al-Buza'a in Safar 11 AH (late summer 632) he pinned the Tamim and Sulaym coalition near the wells of Buza'a so that the enemy was cramped for supply; in the battle of al-Rabadha in Muharram 11 AH he met the Sulaym and Hawazin coalition with cavalry in the passes north-east of Medina and took their camp and herds. In pursuit he did not rush into a set-piece clash: he used small bodies of horse to provoke repeatedly, force the enemy to spread out, and then brought his main weight down on one flank; he then posted riders to block the tribal camps and wells and compelled the tribes to send representatives. The warning recorded by the historians, do not pull the tail of that wild cat, belongs to the battle of al-Buza'a and shows how wary the commanders were of pursuing in scattered columns. Against a fortified town he switched to siege: approaching Ta'if from the south-east of Mecca, he brought mangonels and arrow towers into range, battered the gates for several days without success, was repeatedly countersurprised by sorties from the town, and finally lifted the siege because the walls held and relief kept coming, withdrawing towards Mecca. On the Yemenite front two detached columns moved south along the Red Sea coast, one led by Muhajir ibn Abi Ubayya through Najran and Hadramawt towards Sana'a, the other along the shore, in order to cut the sea supply of the Sassanid garrison. After the capture of Sana'a an agreement was reached inside the city, and a local Yemenite power took it upon itself to drive out the Persian governor. Altogether this army had no integrated system of siege equipment, yet by cavalry speed, surveyed distances and constant relay of messages it achieved a pursuit across half the Arabian peninsula.
data: 年表：632年6月8日穆罕默德去世；632年夏（穆哈拉姆十一年）各部族遣使到麥地那談判，使者被殺，戰爭爆發；同年穆哈拉姆十一年在麥地那東北的拉巴達（al-Rabadha）迎擊蘇萊姆與哈萬津；632年夏末（薩法爾十一年）布扎阿之戰；632年秋（拉比歐阿瓦爾十一年）杜·努韋拉與穆沙拉爾之戰；632年末（朱爾哈達十一年）穆哈拉勒之戰；633年初（拉比歐阿瓦爾十二年）雅馬麥之戰，為全役最激烈的會戰；其後是塔伊弗之圍。距離：麥地那至麥加約四百五十公里，再向東南至塔伊弗約九十公里；麥地那至雅馬麥（一般考訂在卡西姆盆地一帶）約六百公里；麥地那至也門薩那約一千一百公里。行軍多以每日夜行三十至五十公里的速度推進，重要據點之間以駱駝驛站傳令。兵力：史料分歧極大，據伊本·希薩姆與塔巴里的轉述，哈立德在拉巴達作戰時的騎兵約二千人；雅馬麥之戰穆斯林方面常記為數千至萬人，叛軍方面則有兩萬至三萬之說，其中含波斯援兵；歐麥爾與塔米姆的協議則提到塔米姆承諾提供一萬名騎士，顯示叛軍方的兵源規模確實不小。戰役延續約七至八個月，主要戰鬥集中在三個月的窗口內。傷亡與損耗：這場戰爭的編年記載多出自八世紀的敘述者，具體數字極不可靠，只能視為量級而非統計。
dataEn: Chronology: Muhammad died on 8 June 632; in the summer of 632 (Muharram 11 AH) the tribes sent envoys to Medina to negotiate, the envoys were killed and the war began; in the same month of Muharram 11 AH Khalid met the Sulaym and Hawazin coalition at al-Rabadha north-east of Medina; in late summer 632 (Safar 11 AH) came the battle of al-Buza'a; in autumn 632 (Rabi' al-Awwal 11 AH) the fighting at Dhu Nuwayra and al-Musharrar; in late 632 (Dhu al-Qa'dah 11 AH) the battle of al-Muharrah; in early 633 (Rabi' al-Awwal 12 AH) the battle of Yamama, the fiercest engagement of the whole war; the siege of Ta'if came after it. Distances: about 450 kilometres from Medina to Mecca and another 90 kilometres south-east to Ta'if; roughly 600 kilometres from Medina to Yamama, which is generally identified with the Qassim basin; about 1,100 kilometres from Medina to Sana'a in Yemen. Columns generally advanced thirty to fifty kilometres a day by night marches, and messages between the main points were relayed by camel stations. Strength: the sources differ widely. Ibn Ishaq and al-Tabari transmit roughly two thousand cavalry under Khalid at al-Rabadha; at Yamama the Muslim side is commonly given as several thousand up to ten thousand, while the insurgent side is credited with twenty or thirty thousand including Persian reinforcements; the treaty concluded between Umar and Tamim speaks of ten thousand horsemen to be provided by Tamim, which shows that the rebel side could really raise large numbers. The campaign ran about seven or eight months in all, with the main fighting concentrated inside a three-month window. Casualties and losses: the chronicles of this war are almost all the work of eighth-century writers, and the specific figures are unreliable, so they can only be read as orders of magnitude rather than as statistics.
cause: 直接導火線是談判使者被殺。632年夏，各部族遣代表到麥地那請求維持先知時期的舊關係，穆斯納德·本·哈里斯殺死使者，穆罕默德當即表示「他們來求和，你卻殺了他們的使者」，事情再也無法收拾。深層原因有四層。第一是權力真空：先知一死，其生前靠個人威望統合的部族聯盟立即鬆散，麥地那輔士首領伊本·烏拜伊相繼病逝，那些只在外表上順從的偽信士隨即脫去偽裝，公開回到多神信仰與各自的部族忠誠。第二是政權性質的改變：阿布·伯克爾要建立能收稅、能徵兵的中央國家，而部族習慣的是「有求才應」的部族式協議，兩者對忠誠的定義本來就不一致；前線在敘利亞與伊拉克的稅收安排也讓一些部落懷疑新政府。第三是外部競爭：薩珊與拜占庭都在收買邊境上的阿拉伯部落，用金幣、傭兵與顧問維持內陸騷亂，把哈里發國的注意力釘在阿拉伯半島，阻止它轉向敘利亞。第四是宗教層面的嫌隙：受猶太聚落、拜占庭的基督徒傳教士與波斯方面的影響，部分部落並未真心接受伊斯蘭；而麥加禁寺的「帷幕事件」——有人以駱駝氈蓋住天房——被後世記成穆斯林向多神教讓步的恥辱，成為叛軍自我說服的宣傳材料。最後，先知生前對多個部族所許的優厚待遇與稅收優惠，在新政府手中被重新審查，也加深了不滿。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the murder of the emissaries. In the summer of 632 the tribes sent representatives to Medina to ask that the old arrangements of the Prophet's time be maintained; Musnad ibn al-Harith killed an emissary, and the Prophet said at once that they had come seeking peace and he had killed their messenger, after which nothing could be mended. The deeper causes run in four layers. First, a vacuum of authority: with the Prophet dead, the tribal coalition he had held together by personal prestige came apart at once, the head of the Medinan helpers Ibn Ubayy died shortly afterwards, and those who had only outwardly submitted dropped the pretence and went openly back to polytheism and to their own tribal loyalties. Second, a change in the nature of the government: Abu Bakr meant to build a central state able to tax and to conscript, while the tribes were accustomed to a contractual, request-and-response form of alliance, and the two ideas of loyalty had never really coincided; the arrangements for revenue in Syria and Iraq also left some tribes suspicious of the new administration. Third, outside rivalry: both Persia and Byzantium were buying up the Arab tribes on their frontier with coin, mercenaries and advisers, keeping trouble going inland so that the caliphate would stay pinned to the Arabian peninsula instead of turning towards Syria. Fourth, religious friction: influenced by Jewish settlements, Byzantine Christian missionaries and Persian contacts, some tribes had never truly accepted Islam, and the incident of the cloak laid over the Ka'ba in Mecca was later remembered as a humiliation in which the Muslims had conceded to polytheism, which made useful material for the insurgents' propaganda. Finally, the generous terms and tax privileges the Prophet had granted to several tribes were re-examined by the new government, which deepened the resentment.
impact: 里達戰爭是阿拉伯國家的真正起點。此前六十年的傳教運動靠的是個人魅力與零散的部族盟約；此戰之後，麥地那政府第一次用武力把受洗歸順與拒絕歸順兩類人分開，並且用戰爭的勝利把整個半島中部與南部的部族編入同一支軍隊體系。制度上的變化最為深遠：部族首領被哈里發任命的總督取代，傳統的部族首長改為向中央繳納土地稅，而原本作為血仇賠償的罰款被改為直接繳入國庫，軍隊也從部落自備改為由中央發放津貼，騎兵第一次成為可以獨立作戰的常備力量。也門被平定後，薩珊在紅海東岸的前哨被拔除，阿曼與巴林也先後歸附；拜占庭與薩珊因此把注意力重新集中到敘利亞與美索不達米亞，反而為634年之後阿拉伯軍隊的西征與東征騰出空間。情報與編年方面，由於戰事發生在第一批阿拉伯史家的前一代，關於里達的記述幾乎全部出自八世紀的敘述者，因此每一份記載都帶有部落認同與王朝合法性的痕跡，包含大量詩歌、口述與互相矛盾的數字。里達的經驗也留下一條制度教訓：後來的王朝在面對部落叛亂時，往往先以聯姻、收買與外交分化，而不是像哈立德那樣直接用騎兵遠征。
impactEn: The Ridda War is the real starting point of the Arab state. The sixty years of preaching before it rested on personal charisma and scattered tribal covenants; after it the government in Medina had used force for the first time to separate those who had submitted from those who had not, and it had used the victory of the war to fold the tribes of central and southern Arabia into a single military structure. The institutional change was the deepest of all: tribal chiefs were replaced by governors appointed from the caliph's own circle, the old tribal heads were made to pay land tax to the centre, compensation for blood feuds was redirected into the state treasury, and armies ceased to be tribal contingents and became columns paid from the public purse, cavalry for the first time forming a standing force that could fight on its own. With Yemen settled, the Sassanid outposts on the Red Sea coast were torn out, and Oman and Bahrain followed into the fold; Byzantium and Persia both turned their attention back to Syria and Mesopotamia, which left the floor open for the Arab campaigns west and east after 634. As for the record itself, the fighting happened a generation before the first Arab historians, so almost everything known about the Ridda was written by eighth-century authors; every account therefore carries the marks of tribal identity and dynastic legitimacy, and is full of poetry, oral transmission and mutually contradictory figures. The Ridda also left an institutional lesson: later dynasties facing tribal revolt tended to divide opponents first by marriage, payment and diplomacy, rather than sending cavalry across the desert as Khalid did.
result: 戰爭沒有單一會戰可以作為終點，而是一連串的屈服與重新結盟。哈立德在雅馬麥擊潰塔米姆與波斯援軍的聯盟，馬利克·本·努韋拉在戰後的追擊中被殺，這個結果使最硬的一批抵抗者失去領導；塔米姆、蘇萊姆、哈萬津等族先後與中央簽訂協議，其中與塔米姆的協議由歐麥爾派遣阿卜杜·拉赫曼·本·奧夫談成，條款包括重新接受伊斯蘭、繳納既定稅賦以及提供一萬名騎士的兵源。塔伊弗沒有被攻下：城牆與地勢守住了，哈立德在該城折損了包括伊卜拉欣·本·侯賽因在內的將領，數旬之後解除圍城，轉而用別的方式處理豪萬津人，其後數年間該城最終歸順。也門是最後解決的地方：穆哈吉爾·本·阿比·烏拜陣亡後由其子接任，兩軍在桑訥達成協議，薩珊籍的總督被也門本地首領驅逐，叛亂在633至634年間趨於平息。也門平定之後，戰線轉向敘利亞，阿布·伯克爾在634年8月病逝，歐麥爾接任；對伊本·伊沙克、瓦基迪與後來的塔巴里來說，里達的結束意味著統一阿拉伯這件事必須靠持續的征戰而不是一次講和才能完成，而哈立德的騎兵則成為之後耶姆古克與宰邁耶會戰中最受倚重的兵種之一。
resultEn: The war has no single decisive battle to serve as its end; it is a chain of submissions and new alliances. Khalid broke the Tamim and Persian coalition at Yamama, and Malik ibn Nuwayra was killed during the pursuit that followed, which removed the leadership of the hardest-pressed resistance; Tamim, Sulaym, Hawazin and the others then concluded agreements with the centre, and the treaty with Tamim, negotiated by Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf on Umar's orders, provided for renewed acceptance of Islam, the payment of the assessed dues and a levy of ten thousand horsemen. Ta'if was not taken: its walls and its position held, Khalid lost commanders there including Ibrahim ibn al-Husayn, and after a stretch of weeks the siege was lifted and the Hawazin were handled in other ways, the city eventually submitting in the years that followed. Yemen was settled last: after Muhajir ibn Abi Ubayya was killed his son took over, an agreement was reached at Sana'a, the Persian governor was driven out by a local Yemenite leader, and the rebellion wound down between 633 and 634. With Yemen settled the front moved to Syria, Abu Bakr died in August 634 and Umar succeeded him. For Ibn Ishaq, al-Waqidi and the later al-Tabari, the end of the Ridda meant that the unification of Arabia would have to be achieved by continuous campaigning rather than by a single negotiated settlement, and Khalid's cavalry became one of the most trusted arms of the armies that later fought at Yarmouk and al-Qadisiyyah.
